# licensed falsehood

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:veridicalityLicensedFalsehood`](gmeow-veridicalityLicensedFalsehood.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/veridicalityLicensedFalsehood>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md), [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The claim is fiction, satire, sarcasm, or another form of falsehood that is socially licensed and not deceptive — the audience understands the non-truth-asserting frame. This safety property separates harmless fictional assertion from deception ([Principle 1](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-1): model what should have been written).
